cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

mechanism: Copy wedding place-card numbering as a tissue-issuance process, treating distress as a request that needs classification and a signature.
confusable: Not generic emotional bureaucracy alone: B2 must correct the misunderstood cause of tears, and A3 must cling to the copied seating method.
comparison: Family wedding support contrasts with a friendship umbrella loan.
